BiblicalUsage: The word hădôm carries the sense of a foot stool. In 1 Chronicles 28:2, the text says "and for the footstool of our God." In Psalm 99:5, the text says "and worship at his footstool."
TheologicalSignificance: hădôm convinces me that worship is not a performance but a response — we answer what God has done with what we are. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
